assign.outcome:
**The magazine, blog, screens and shells are IN the paging system now — each drawn by its own module, imported read-only, under five surfaces and three type scales.**

[**Templates**](/imagine/paging/templates/) — the hub: *a template is a whole page shape you can start from; pick one, and the page you make wears it.* Eleven family cards, each a live example, not a screenshot.

![](magazine-1280.png)

## The four the owner named — integrated, not sampled

| family | what actually runs | page |
|---|---|---|
| Magazine | `mag.column()` · `contents.previews()` · `Article.preview()` | [/templates/magazine/](/imagine/paging/templates/magazine/) |
| Blog | `Post.hero()` · a real `Section.content()` · `Post.wall()` | [/templates/blog/](/imagine/paging/templates/blog/) |
| Screens | `area()` · `frames()` from `screens/screen.js` | [/templates/screens/](/imagine/paging/templates/screens/) |
| Shells | a real `Shell` — `rail()` `bar()` `main()` `nav_links()` | [/templates/shells/](/imagine/paging/templates/shells/) |

Each one is themed live: the five surface chips **and a new `compact` / `regular` / `display` typography chip** repaint the same example, with no reload. Measured: the magazine cover title reads 34.2 / 42.8 / 57.7px across the three words, and the surface chip flips the column to `color-scheme: dark` with one navigation entry on the clock.

![](magazine-dark-display.png)

## The other seven, and the wall

[Decks](/imagine/paging/templates/decks/) · [Columns](/imagine/paging/templates/columns/) · [Layouts](/imagine/paging/templates/layouts/) · [Sections](/imagine/paging/templates/sections/) · [UI](/imagine/paging/templates/ui/) · [UX](/imagine/paging/templates/ux/) · [Navigation](/imagine/paging/templates/navigation/) — one iconic example each, drawn by `region()`/`statement()`, `shape()`, `hero(tone)`, `new Pagination()`, `new Tags()`, and the `ui-crumbs` template.

[**The theming wall**](/imagine/paging/templates/theming/) — the same real blog section fifteen times: five surfaces across, three type scales down, the token that does each one printed beside it.

![](theming-3440.png)

## What Make cannot say yet

Make's line is `Title: style content mechanism` — **not one of those three words is a template.** The proposal, with the exact grammar and what a single word still cannot carry (an issue, a section, a part list, a cut): [**doc/templates.md**](/imagine/paging/doc/templates.md). Also there: a one-line `Shell.css` diff that would delete the only rule this realm restates from another module.

## Two things found and fixed

- **`.blog-hero` is an inline-size container that also says `align-self: start`.** In a flex column those meet and the hero measured a few px wide — it set its own title one character per line. One declaration fixes it, and it has to out-specify `.blog-hero` because `blog.css` loads *after* this sheet.
- **`paging/readme.md` is wrong about `Post.js`.** Every `.page-previews` rule in `blog.css` is scoped; importing the class is safe.

## Proof

All 13 pages headless at 1280 and 3440: **zero console errors**, zero horizontal overflow, nothing framed or textual at x:0, no prose past the measure. [readme](/imagine/paging/templates/readme/).

## Left

- The hub leaves ~750px of the row empty at 3440 — it is `large` because its children open beside it, and `fill` would squeeze them to their floor.
- The seven smaller families have one example each, not the full treatment — the brief's own priority order.
- `templates` was wired into `/imagine/paging/`'s `children:` here (one word); that file is `paging-mechanisms-v2`'s, so it needs re-checking if that task rewrites it.
